entries.reason: Optional generated terrain colliders retain only owner-qualified runtime handles across frame and teardown boundaries.
entries.create: replace creates World3D-owned static bodies and publishes world/body handles only after every tile collider succeeds.
entries.ownership: World3D solely owns bodies and shapes; the runtime owns only typed process-local links.
entries.destroy_order: Runtime-first destroys resolved bodies; world-first removes the world registry entry and all later resolutions return stale null.
entries.restore: Links are never persisted; callers rebuild them by replacing from the restored GtsTerrainLodSet.
entries.stale: World and body generation-qualified handles are both resolved before any access or destruction.

entries.reason: The L-system recipe is a deterministic generation system with explicit seed/grammar inputs.
evidence: docs/dev/重构代码质量与系统完整性规范.md
entries.entity_scope: Owning grammar/axiom state inside one LSystem instance.
entries.view: Local grammar expansion view; no ECS entities are traversed.
entries.read_set: Axiom, production rules, iteration count, seed and turtle interpretation parameters.
entries.write_set: Generated string/mesh candidates owned by the caller or recipe output.
entries.structural_changes: No ECS structural mutation; generated artifacts publish only through procgen artifact admission.
entries.events: No runtime events; diagnostics are returned through recipe error channels.
entries.services: Injected Params and recipe registry; no retained callbacks.
